message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine statutory charges based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: a public official (林某甲) abused position to accept bribes in exchange for influencing procurement bidding. This is bribery (受贿) by a public official. Also possibly "行贿" but the official is the recipient, so "受贿罪". Also "滥用职权" maybe but main is "受贿罪". The amount: total 184,000 + 45,000 = 229,000 RMB. Under Chinese law, bribery amounts: "数额较大" (over 100,000 but less than 500,000) qualifies as "受贿罪" with sentencing. Also there is "单位行贿罪"? No, the official is individual. So charge: 受贿罪. Also maybe "徇私舞弊罪"? But typical is "受贿罪". The question: "Give the statutory charge(s) for this fact. Answer on one line." So output format: [罪名]受贿<eoa>. If multiple, separate with semicolon. Only one.

Thus final answer.
